title: Final Radius
description: Essential Criteria: The correct radius of the sphere must be stated as r_0 = d/8.

title: Final Force
description: Essential Criteria: The force on each charge must be correctly expressed as F = QV/(8d).

title: Use of Symmetry
description: Important Criteria: The reasoning should include the symmetry of the charge distribution and its effect on the forces.

title: Potential Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the potential due to the sphere must be correctly derived.

title: Electric Field Direction
description: Optional Criteria: The direction of the electric field created by the sphere should be mentioned.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any unit mistakes in the final answers will lead to a deduction.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common sign mistakes in the force calculation will result in a deduction.
